description: Main source code for sensor data acquisition and configuration on the X-NUCLEO-IKS01A3 platform using Zephyr RTOS. It initializes sensors, sets configurations, fetches sensor data, and displays it in a loop.

methods.name: lis2dw12_trigger_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for LIS2DW12 sensor trigger events.

methods.name: lsm6dso_acc_trig_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for LSM6DSO accelerometer trigger events.

methods.name: lis2dw12_config
methods.description: Configures LIS2DW12 sensor sampling frequency and full scale, sets trigger if enabled.

methods.name: lsm6dso_config
methods.description: Configures LSM6DSO sensor sampling frequencies, full scales, and triggers for accelerometer, gyroscope, and optional sensors.
